input: Research cold plunge therapy benefits and local spots

gold.taskTitle: Research Cold Plunge Therapy Benefits and Local Spots
gold.taskDescription: Research the health benefits of cold plunge therapy and find local venues or options where the user can experience it.

questions.title: What specific health goal is driving your interest?
questions.description: Understanding the primary motivation (e.g., muscle recovery, mental health, weight loss) will focus the research on the most relevant benefits.

questions.title: Have you ever done a cold plunge before?
questions.description: Knowing the user's experience level helps tailor recommendations for beginners versus those already familiar with the practice.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the local search cover?
questions.description: A specific location is needed to find relevant gyms, spas, or wellness centers offering cold plunge facilities nearby.

questions.title: Are you looking to visit a facility or buy equipment?
questions.description: Determining whether the user wants to use an outside venue or set up a personal cold plunge at home will shape the research direction.

questions.title: What is your budget per session or for equipment?
questions.description: A budget range will help filter options appropriately, whether evaluating day-pass prices at spas or the cost of personal tubs.

questions.title: Do you have any medical conditions relevant to cold exposure?
questions.description: Conditions such as heart issues, Raynaud's disease, or hypertension affect safety guidelines and which benefits apply to the user.

questions.title: What sources do you trust most for health research?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user prefers peer-reviewed studies, expert practitioner opinions, or popular wellness content will guide how evidence is presented.
